input: internet down since this morning. router light is red. work from home, please help
expected:
Sorry, I know how disruptive that is when you work from home. First, check the Service status tile in the app or brightwave.example/status for an outage in your area. If nothing is listed:
1. Switch the router off at the wall for 30 seconds, then turn it back on and wait 5 minutes.
2. Check that the fibre cable from the wall box is firmly clicked into the router and isn't bent.
Is the light still red after that?

input: Still red after restarting and the cable is fine
expected: Thanks for checking. A red light after a restart, with the cable fine, usually means there's no signal reaching your home, which needs our team to look at the line. I've passed this to our support team to arrange a line check and an engineer visit if needed, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. Until then, you can use your mobile as a hotspot if your plan includes data.

input: wifi is so slow in the evenings. paying for 500mb and getting like 40
expected:
Sorry it's so slow. Evening slowdowns are often about Wi-Fi rather than the line. Try these:
1. Test the speed with a cable plugged into the router, or standing right next to it.
2. Connect to the 5 GHz network (it's the name ending in -5G).
3. Pause big downloads, game updates or 4K streams on other devices.
What speed do you get with the cable test? If it's still far below 500 Mb, we'll look into the line.

input: Why is my first bill so high?! It's almost double what I signed up for
expected: I understand the surprise. Most first bills are higher because they include two parts: a pro-rata charge for the days between your start date and your first billing date, plus the first full month in advance. After that, the bill should match your monthly price. You can see the breakdown in App > Bills > View bill. If the amounts still look wrong, let me know and I'll pass it to our team to check.

input: I got charged $45 roaming in Mexico, I thought roaming was included!!
expected: Sorry for the shock. Roaming is included in 40 destination countries on Plus and Max plans, and Mexico isn't one of them at the moment, so a daily roaming pass is charged for each day you used data or calls there. You can see the countries and daily prices in App > Roaming. If you think a charge is wrong, for example on days you weren't there, I can pass it to our team to review.

input: How do I set up eSIM on my new iPhone
expected:
Here's how:
1. In the Brightwave app, go to SIM > Get eSIM and choose your new phone.
2. On the iPhone, go to Settings > Mobile Data > Add eSIM and scan the QR code shown in our app.
3. Keep Wi-Fi on and wait a few minutes for it to activate.
Your physical SIM stops working once the eSIM is active, so do this when you're ready to switch.

input: I'm porting my number from my old provider, it's been 3 days and still not moved
expected: Sorry for the wait. Number transfers usually complete within 1 business day, so three days is longer than it should be. I've passed this to our support team to check the transfer with your old provider, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. Please keep your old SIM in your phone until the transfer finishes, so you can still receive calls.

input: My phone suddenly says No Service and I just got an email saying my password was reset, I didn't do that
expected: This could be someone trying to take over your number, so it's urgent. Please call 0800 BRIGHT from another phone now. I've also flagged it to our team, who will act within the hour. Don't share any codes you receive by email or text with anyone. If you use this number for banking, contact your bank as well.

input: we're moving house next month, can I take my broadband with me?
expected: Yes, in most cases you can. Request the move at least 14 days ahead in App > Account > Moving home, giving your new address and moving date. We'll check fibre availability there and confirm whether an installation visit is needed. Take your router with you when you go.

input: I want to cancel. What's the fee?
expected: Sorry to hear you want to leave. Any early termination fee depends on how long is left on your contract, so I've passed your request to our support team to confirm the exact amount and the options with you before anything changes. They'll get back to you within 1 business day. If you're out of contract, there's no fee, just 30 days' notice.

input: can i add a streaming service to my plan
expected: Yes, you can. Go to App > Plan > Add-ons and choose the streaming add-on. The monthly price shows before you confirm, and it's added to your next bill. If you already subscribe to that service directly, you can link your existing account so you keep your profiles and history.

input: Hi I'm 79 and my personal alarm pendant runs on my phone line. Internet has been down two days.
expected: Thank you for telling me. Because your alarm relies on the line, I've passed this to our support team as a priority, with a note about the pendant, and they'll contact you within 1 business day, likely sooner. Please keep a charged mobile phone nearby in case you need help in the meantime. If you have someone who can check on you, let them know too.

input: what's my PUK code? phone locked
expected: You can find your PUK code in the Brightwave app under SIM > Show PUK. If you can't get into the app because the phone is locked, log in at brightwave.example on another device and go to the same menu. Enter the code carefully: too many wrong tries can permanently block the SIM.

input: Absolutely fed up. Third outage this month, I want money off my bill.
expected: I'm sorry, three outages in a month isn't good enough, and I understand why you're fed up. I can't apply credits myself, but I've passed your request and the outage history to our support team, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. If you're offline right now, check brightwave.example/status for updates on the current fault.

input: Wifi keeps disconnecting on my laptop but phone is fine
expected:
Since your phone stays connected, the problem is probably on the laptop. Try these:
1. Choose "Forget this network" on the laptop, then reconnect.
2. Try the other Wi-Fi network (the one ending in -5G, or the one without it).
3. Update the laptop's Wi-Fi drivers or system updates.
Does it still drop after that?

input: How do I return the router? I cancelled last week
expected: We'll post you a prepaid returns bag automatically, usually within 5 days of your service ending. Put the router and power cable in the bag and drop it at any post office. Please return it within 30 days, or a $60 non-return fee applies. Keep the post office receipt until we confirm we've received it.

input: hi, my data ran out already its only the 12th. can I get more, and is there a bigger plan
expected: Yes to both. For an instant top-up, go to App > Plan > Data top-up. It's added straight away and billed on your next bill. For a bigger allowance every month, check App > Plan > Change plan to compare plans, with the prices shown before you confirm. Upgrades usually start immediately.

input: is there an outage in my area? postcode 4021
expected: I can't confirm outages from this chat, but the status page shows live faults by area. Check brightwave.example/status or the Service status tile in the app and enter your postcode. If nothing is listed and you're having trouble, tell me what's happening, like no connection or slow speeds, and the router light colour, and we'll troubleshoot.

input: The technician didn't show up today. I took the day off work for this!!
expected: I'm so sorry. You took the day off and nobody came, and that's really frustrating. I've passed this to our support team so they can find out what happened, rebook a visit at a time that suits you and look at your request for the missed day. They'll get back to you within 1 business day.

input: why does my bill have a late payment fee, I paid on time
expected: Sorry about that. A late fee is added if a payment hasn't reached us by the due date. Card payments made on the due date sometimes arrive a day late. You can check the payment date and the due date in App > Bills. If your payment was made before the due date, I'll pass it to our team to review. Just let me know the date and how you paid.

input: Can I keep my number if I switch to you from another network?
expected: Yes. When you order, choose "Keep my number" and enter your number and your transfer code from your current provider. Most networks give you the code instantly by text. The transfer usually completes within 1 business day, and you'll have a temporary number until then.

input: my tv add on keeps buffering
expected:
Sorry about that. Buffering is usually caused by the connection to the TV box. Try:
1. Restart the TV box and your router.
2. If possible, connect the TV box with an ethernet cable.
3. Pause big downloads on other devices while you watch.
If it still buffers, tell me whether it happens on every channel or only some.

input: Do you have 5G in Lakeside?
expected: You can check 5G coverage for any address on our coverage map at brightwave.example/coverage. Enter the postcode for a street-level view. Coverage indoors can differ from outdoors, so the map shows both.

input: i'm being charged for a phone i returned months ago
expected: Sorry, that shouldn't happen. Do you have the return receipt or tracking number from when you sent the phone back? I've passed this to our support team to trace the return and correct the charges, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. If you send the receipt details here, I'll add them to the note.

input: can you lower my bill? money is tight right now
expected: Thank you for telling me, and I'm sorry things are hard right now. I can't change prices myself, but there are options, such as moving to a lower plan or a social tariff if you qualify. I've passed your message to our support team to go through them with you, and they'll get back to you within 1 business day. You can also compare cheaper plans now in App > Plan > Change plan.
